intro: Surena Caledon is a warlock training task given by Gakin the Darkbinder in the hidden basement beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. Gakin tasks an aspiring warlock with hunting down his former pupil, who betrayed him to run off with the Defias Brotherhood, and reclaiming a prized bloodstone choker.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had a student named Surena Caledon. She stood where you stand now, eager to learn of warlock magic, and possessing no small bit of talent. More than that she was young and pleasing to the eye. Had I seen it then, the traitorous trollop!
The thieving wench ran off with one of the Defias, Erlan Drudgemoor. While her loss is of little importance, I gifted her a bloodstone choker that I must have.
Her life means nothing to me now. You will find her at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Retrieve what is mine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Even the older and wiser can be unmanned by the wiles of youth and beauty, friend. A piece of advice you would do well to remember throughout your life.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Surena was talented, but not enough so to gain mastery of warlock magic on her own. It's a shame to see talent wasted, but sometimes it is necessary.
I hope my investment in you will bear different results.
